product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle is a revenue-assurance platform for product, eCommerce, marketing, and engineering teams that quantifies the cost of digital friction, prioritizes fixes, and measures their ROI.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page describes quantifying friction costs, prioritizing fixes, and proving ROI; the homepage identifies the intended teams: https://bluetriangle.com/company and https://bluetriangle.com/.

pricing_page.notes: A public plan-selection page lists several plans, including Enterprise with custom pricing. Published numeric prices are not required by the question: https://portal.bluetriangle.com/btportal/web/index.php?r=checkout%2Fpackage.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both The Home Depot and Lowe's appear in the company's 'Trusted by enterprise brands' customer wall: https://www.bluetriangle.com/. | named_customers.0: The Home Depot appears on Blue Triangle's customer wall. | named_customers.1: Lowe's appears on Blue Triangle's customer wall.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly reports 21–50 employees. Other sources give differing counts, so this band is not treated as an exact verified headcount: https://prospeo.io/c/blue-triangle-revenue.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official contact page gives a Glen Allen address, and the company's LinkedIn profile labels Glen Allen as headquarters. These take precedence over an older Mechanicsville listing: https://bluetriangle.com/contact-us and https://linkedin.com/company/blue-triangle-technologies/jobs. | hq_country: The company's contact page gives a Glen Allen, Virginia address, and the company profile identifies its country as the United States: https://bluetriangle.com/contact-us and https://prospeo.io/c/blue-triangle-revenue.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook explicitly states that Blue Triangle was founded in 2011: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/83782-72.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents product announcements and customer-facing experience-optimization content; it did not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how Blue Triangle builds its product. This is a negative under the specified engineering-blog test: https://bluetriangle.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation hub provides multiple sections covering getting started, APIs, SDKs, data collection, the portal, and other product functionality: https://help.bluetriangle.com/help-center/documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The accessible company job-board profile lists no current openings, including no qualifying AI/ML/data-science role. Its wording is limited to jobs relevant to that board: https://careers.saasventurecapital.com/companies/blue-triangle.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model/provider was identified after checking product and AI documentation, FAQ, blog, security documentation, and the published subprocessor list. Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor are described as external MCP clients, not as the provider behind the built-in assistant. Sources include https://help.bluetriangle.com/help-center/assistant-ai-overview, https://bluetriangle.com/blog/blue-triangle-mcp-ai-assistant-access, and https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/Blue_Triangle_June_2023/pdf/Blue%20Triangle%20Subprocessor%20List%202023.pdf.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Legal & Trust Center offers a SOC-2 report and ISO27001 documentation on request, without describing either as in progress. Only these two named claims are included: https://bluetriangle.com/legal-trust. | compliance_certs.0: The official trust page offers a SOC-2 report on request. | compliance_certs.1: The official trust page names ISO27001 documentation available on request.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: LeadIQ and VCBacked classify the November 2021 round as Series B; PitchBook uses the broader label 'Later Stage VC': https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211 and https://www.vcbacked.co/company/blue-triangle. | funding_date: Two profiles identify November 9, 2021 as the latest funding date, normalized to YYYY-MM: https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211 and https://www.vcbacked.co/company/blue-triangle. | funding_amount_usd: The latest round's amount is explicitly undisclosed. Cumulative funding totals and amounts from older rounds have not been substituted: https://www.vcbacked.co/company/blue-triangle and https://millionrounds.com/company/blue-triangle.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was November 9, 2021, before the requested 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025: https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211 and https://www.vcbacked.co/company/blue-triangle.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible job-board profile lists no current openings, and the discovered SDR posting explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications: https://careers.saasventurecapital.com/companies/blue-triangle and https://careers.saasventurecapital.com/companies/blue-triangle/jobs/28126921-sales-development-representative.

launched_6mo.notes: Blue Triangle announced its new MCP connector in August 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026. It enables querying real-user data through compatible AI assistants: https://bluetriangle.com/blog/blue-triangle-mcp-ai-assistant-access.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Emily Salzer's profile dates her start as Vice President of Customer Success to January 2026, following her Strategic Customer Success Director role. This is an internal VP appointment within the window, not a departure or a new company hire: https://linkedin.com/in/emily-salzer-19007443.
